label: The centre of the board
about: E5 is the centre of the 9x9 board, the point of symmetry for the whole board. Black plays there. ← shows the empty board.

label: Three-space jump on the edge
about: Black's two stones on the third line of the left edge, C7 and C3, have three empty points between them. The middle one, C5, is the point of symmetry: White splits them there. ← shows the position before.

label: Between a knight's move
about: White's knight's move on the right side, G6 and H4. The two points between them, G5 and H5, are mirror images around its centre. Black plays between at G5. ← shows the position before.
